Started serving customers on July 21, 2025. at 7001 Santa Monica Blvd, but be aware the exterior is recycled Cybertruck stainless and it has two floors with more than 250 seats across both floors, so plan for a big visit. You get 80 charging bays here which is the largest urban Supercharging station in the world, plus the rooftop Skypad offers views of the Hollywood Hills where screens are 66 feet wide for the drive-in theater experience. Daily hours: 06:00 to 00:00 and while you wait, you can see the Optimus robot is on display and shop for merch on the Skypad, though note the beef supplier is Brandt Beef and cost is $13.50 per burger.

The place finally opened its doors on July 21, 2025, and with 80 V4 Supercharger stalls it is the largest urban Supercharging station in the world, which is ABSOLUTELY INSANE! Unfortunately, Eric Greenspan is gone as of Nov 2025 and they do not serve alcohol, plus they only take digital and card payments. Constructed from repurposed Cybertruck stainless steel, the Two-level structure houses More than 250 seats across both floors and Max power is 325 kW for everyone. I drove up to 7001 Santa Monica Blvd, LA area, and even though No parking for non-EVs, use street or garages, it was still a wild experience to see the Optimus bot in action.

Opening day was July 21st, 2025, and the double-decker layout with built recycled Cybertruck stainless steel was instantly iconic compared to any other spot in West Hollywood. The Skypad on the second floor offers stunning views of the Hollywood Hills while you watch movies on the 66 feet wide screens from your table. It is amazing to see the Optimus bot serve popcorn while you grab merchandise at the shop on the Skypad with over 250 seats total. Just remember that cash is not taken, parking requires charging or street spots, and the chef departed November 2025 but the vibe remains electric.

I was frustrated to find that non-chargers need street parking or nearby garages since the lot is reserved for EV charging. After the 2018 announcement, it opened July 21, 2025, and while the building made of recycled stainless steel from Cybertrucks is cool, I noticed Chef left in November 2025. The Skypad rooftop offers great views of the Hollywood Hills and features an Optimus humanoid robot while you watch movies on the two 66' LED screens.
Started serving customers on July 21, 2025, with 80 V4 charging spots that make it the largest urban Supercharging station in the world.

After the 2018 announcement, it opened July 21, 2025, and honestly I was ready to spend big but Burgers are $13.50 which is actually a steal. I pulled up to 7001 Santa Monica Blvd, LA area in my Model S and saw Built from recycled Cybertruck stainless steel before heading inside where It has two floors. You get up to 325kW charging power here with 80 Supercharger V4s and Two 66' LED screens for the drive-in movie experience while Fits over 250 diners. It was a shock to learn Brandt Beef only was used but the whole place felt hollow after Chef Eric Greenspan departed November 2025. Hours are 6am to 12am so I grabbed a hot dog and a soda, 13 bucks for a hot dog and Drinks from $4, then climbed to the rooftop Skypad sells branded items where Features an Optimus humanoid robot.

i went here after the 2018 announcement, it opened July 21, 2025. the food is great and sourced from brandt beef, priced at $13.50 for a burger. built from recycled cybertruck stainless steel, it has two floors with 80 v4 charging spots. optimus robot is on display and screens are 66 feet wide for the drive-in movie. they serve from 6 in the morning until midnight with general menu is $4-$15.

It officially opened on July 21, 2025. and with 80 V4 Supercharger stalls, the Tesla Diner is claimed to be the largest urban Supercharging station in the world. Soda starts at $4 but the quality is just average for the price. Chef Eric Greenspan designed the menu, though he later departed and severed ties with the diner in November 2025.
the vibe at the skypad with the hollywood hills views is just insane.

Found at 7001 Santa Monica Blvd. so i stopped by after seeing the news that They launched to the public on 7/21/2025. Constructed from repurposed Cybertruck stainless steel. Two-level structure. Capacity is over 250 seats. Daily hours: 06:00 to 00:00. Features 80 V4 stalls. Non-chargers need street parking or nearby garages. No cash, just card/digital. Max power is 325 kW. Drinks from $4. Items range from $4 to $15. 13.50 for a burger. 15 bucks for a premium sandwich. Cost is $13 per hot dog. Beef supplier is Brandt Beef. Optimus humanoid on site. Chef Eric Greenspan departed in November 2025. Merch sold on the Skypad level. 66 ft LED displays. The vibe feels a bit sterile even with the Optimus humanoid on site. Went in just because the hype was insane, especially with the 66 ft LED displays and the Skypad views. Also kinda weird that they don't serve alcohol and Chef Eric Greenspan departed in November 2025 so the menu feels incomplete now.
